title: Seating Without Feuds
description:
## Task

`guests` people, numbered `0` to `guests - 1`, are to sit in a single row of chairs. Some pairs are feuding and must not sit in neighbouring chairs. Count the different seat orders (permutations of all guests) in which no feuding pair is adjacent. A feud works in both directions.

## Input

- `guests` — the number of guests.
- `feuds` — a list of `[a, b]` pairs of distinct guests who must not sit side by side. A pair may be listed more than once.

## Output

The number of valid seat orders.

## Example

```python
seating_without_feuds(3, [[0, 1]])  # returns 2   (the orders 0 2 1 and 1 2 0)
seating_without_feuds(3, [])  # returns 6
seating_without_feuds(2, [[0, 1]])  # returns 0
```

## Constraints

- 1 ≤ `guests` ≤ 12
- 0 ≤ length of `feuds` ≤ 66
- The answer fits in a normal 64-bit integer.
signature: def seating_without_feuds(guests: int, feuds: list[list[int]]) -> int
